author: sethmako
quote:
I've been waiting 13 years for this game to come out, as many other have, and unfortunately, despite all the hype and anticipation, what we got ended up being a massive disappointment. Where do I even start...
1. The game is limited to consoles, and the optimization is so bad that it can't even hold a steady 30 fps, unless you drop 1000$ on the highest-tier console available. No framegen to help it, no lower resolution performance mode, nothing. For the "next generation" of the grand theft auto series, this is a massive letdown, and leads to our next point.
2. The physics are tied to framerate. The drops in framerate not only give me and others headaches, but they severely negatively impact gameplay as well. Tying physics to framerate has been a no-no in the industry for decades, and despite GTA V not having this issue, GTA VI, running on the same engine, does. It's completely baffling why they would do this, as it causes game-breaking glitches like falling through the map, vehicles flying through the air, objects not moving as expected, missed inputs, etc. For 13 years of development, releasing it in this state is unacceptable.
3. The main characters are awful, and the story sends a bad message. Lucia is a woman that abandons her child, robs a bank, and ends up in jail. She doesn't regret it, and calls it a "bad day" to try and push the viewer to feel sympathy. She's cheating on Jason, she uses him constantly, and berates him over and over. And Jason has almost no personality whatsoever. He's completely insufferable to listen to, and he has no will of his own, just doing everything his psychopathic girlfriend that you have no option but to be with tells him, which leads to another point.
4. Story progression. It would be acceptable to have the relationship stuff as an optional side mission to get weapons or cars or skins, but having the menial tasks, chores, and the requirement to please and make the awful female protagonist happy to progress the main storyline is insulting and a complete slap in the face to the target demographic. This is GTA, not The Sims. People want to steal cars and sleep with prostitutes, not paint the walls for you awful lady-friend. That bring up the next point.
5. Where's the GTA? It would be one thing to change the formula a bit and create different ways to steal cars instead of all prior games having the triangle button be the only thing required to take anyone's car, but this is on a whole 'mother level of insulting. You need to clone keys to get cars, and you need to unlock the ability to drive more premium cars. You can't just steal an expensive car right off the bat, even though the realism of that is completely detached from reality. And even after gaining that ability, you STILL don't get to keep the car, you have to PAY to get it registered. Pay. To get it registered. A stolen car. Registered. In the single player campaign. It's just a big F U to every fan of the series, and completely against everything the franchise stands for (you know, THE TITLE OF THE GAME)
Overall, I couldn't be more disappointed. This game has completely ruined Rockstar's reputation for me, and I won't be purchasing any further entries from them. If this is the best they can do with 13 years and 2,000,000,000$, then everything else from here on out is a pass for me. 2/10
